experiment_data.hypothesis: Labeling quality analysis: (a) tie rate across episodes, (b) genuine vs tie-break label fraction, (c) strict-only retrain sensitivity. Addresses oracle circularity reviewer concern.
experiment_data.notes: Key finding: NO tie-break labels exist in the labeling pipeline. Ties (61.2%) are excluded as no-preference. All 95 training labels are genuine (70 death asymmetry + 16 score comparison for det-preferred; 5 death asymmetry + 4 score comparison for internal-preferred). Strict-only retrain uses identical data and produces balanced_acc=0.5729 (within 1σ of ablation-b mean 0.5761±0.005). The oracle circularity concern about tie-breaking is unfounded. High seed variance in recall trade-off (σ≈0.10) but stable balanced_acc (σ≈0.005).
